name: Ramssol Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，Ramssol Group Berhad 通过 Rams Fintech Sdn Bhd 完成收购 INNIO Holding Sdn Bhd 60% 股权及 Agensi Pekerjaan INNIO Sdn Bhd 49% 股权，扩展 Earned Wage Access 与人力资源相关业务；同时签署条款书，拟以 RM35.00 million 收购 GeekStart Company Limited 额外 48.997% 股权，增持其泰国子公司权益。
overview_en: In 2026, Ramssol Group Berhad, through Rams Fintech Sdn Bhd, completed the acquisitions of a 60% equity interest in INNIO Holding Sdn Bhd and a 49% equity interest in Agensi Pekerjaan INNIO Sdn Bhd, expanding its Earned Wage Access and human resources-related business; it also entered into a term sheet to acquire an additional 48.997% equity interest in GeekStart Company Limited for RM35.00 million, increasing its stake in the Thai subsidiary.

segments.name: Earned Wage Access
segments.note: 通过 Rams Fintech 完成对 INNIO Holding 和 Agensi Pekerjaan INNIO 的股权收购，扩展员工薪资预支及人力资源相关服务。
segments.note_en: Through Rams Fintech, completed acquisitions of equity interests in INNIO Holding and Agensi Pekerjaan INNIO, expanding employee earned wage access and human resources-related services.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 收购 INNIO Holding 60% 股权及 Agensi Pekerjaan INNIO 49% 股权的交易完成。
actions.text_en: The acquisitions of a 60% equity interest in INNIO Holding and a 49% equity interest in Agensi Pekerjaan INNIO were completed.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Rams Fintech 提议收购 INNIO Holding 60% 股权及 Agensi Pekerjaan INNIO 49% 股权。
actions.text_en: Rams Fintech proposed to acquire a 60% equity interest in INNIO Holding and a 49% equity interest in Agensi Pekerjaan INNIO.

segments.name: Human Capital Management & Learning Plat
segments.note: 签署条款书，拟增持泰国子公司 GeekStart 权益。
segments.note_en: Entered into a term sheet to increase its equity interest in Thai subsidiary GeekStart.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Rams Thailand 与卖方签署具约束力条款书，拟以 RM35.00 million 收购 GeekStart 48.997% 股权，其中约 RM20.04 million 以现金支付，另发行 21,000,000 股新股（每股 RM0.7125）支付。
actions.text_en: Rams Thailand entered into a binding term sheet with the seller to acquire a 48.997% equity interest in GeekStart for RM35.00 million, to be satisfied via approximately RM20.04 million in cash and the issuance of 21,000,000 new shares at RM0.7125 per share.
